message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the CSV data or image files loaded in get_df() or QDDataset.__getitem__(); cv2.imread results are used directly without null/shape checks.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths (os.path.join, cv2.imread) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks present anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only maps labels to indices via a label2idx dictionary without any validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection steps, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering applied to training samples anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained models are loaded via geffnet.create_model and resnest loaders with pretrained=False/True flags but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of downloaded weights.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training; labels are simply mapped and used directly.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or supporting files.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard PyTorch optimizers and Apex AMP with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (loss, accuracy, AUC) are computed and a fold-based split is used, there is no held-out test set isolated from training folds, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no independent evaluation protocol to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The dataset __getitem__ reads images directly from disk via cv2.imread and casts to float32 without any shape, range, or validity checks on the loaded data.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (logits/probs) are collected and used directly with no NaN guards, probability range checks, or sanity bounds applied before returning or evaluating them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision-based ML pipeline (image classification), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
